title: Fazbear Expansion
description: Fazbear Expansion adds Minecraft styled FNAF Decor and Animatronics
body:
Bring the world of Five Nights at Freddy's into Minecraft with a collection of Minecraft-styled decorations, blocks, items, and animatronics!

Build your very own Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria using a wide variety of themed decorations, furniture, props, and building blocks. Whether you're creating a faithful recreation or your own original restaurant, you'll have plenty of pieces to work with.

Survival Mode offers a different experience! Explore the world to discover abandoned pizzerias and forgotten locations filled with rare decorations, hidden loot, and decommissioned animatronics. Salvage what you can, craft new decorations, and slowly build the ultimate Fazbear restaurant.

🔧 Features:

- Minecraft-style FNAF decorations and building blocks
- Collectible items and themed furniture
- Salvageable animatronics found in world structures
- Survival progression with exploration and crafting
- Perfect for builders, roleplay, and FNAF fans alike!

⚠️ Beta Warning: This mod is still in Beta. Bugs, missing features, and changes are to be expected as development continues. Thank you for your patience and for helping improve the mod!
